text:
emily: Heads-up 44 console flagged a weird p99 drift on /v1/generate ~1768004400 right after we rolled the route-quota compression change. small spike + sample_count roughly same.
zane: Which compression? the tdigest-centroid compaction we shipped last week?
luca: Yes. compression_level=high rolled to us-east-1 at 1768004280. It compacts centroids aggressively to save storage.
priya: We also shortened the aggregate_window from 60s -> 15s for faster dashboard responsiveness. Two simultaneous changes is suspicious.
emily: Quick breakdown: sample_origin=client p99 stable, sample_origin=aggregator shows the spike. merged-rollup p99 jumps to ~560ms.
monitor-bot: rollout: quota-compression v2 applied to cluster us-east-1 at 1768004280 by @luca.
zane: High compression + shorter window could fragment centroids and make tdigest merges non-commutative at our scale. That can inflate tail when small hosts contribute heavy values.
luca: Our tdigest merge implementation degrades when centroid_count << N. Merge order matters.
priya: Query I ran to inspect per-host quantiles:
```
SELECT host, sample_origin, count(*) as cnt, percentile(lat_ms, 50) as p50, percentile(lat_ms,95) as p95, percentile(lat_ms,99) as p99
FROM latency_events
WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND ts BETWEEN 1768004200 AND 1768004500
GROUP BY host, sample_origin
```
emily: Results: host-a(client): cnt=9k p99=380, host-b(client): cnt=3k p99=400; aggregator-b: cnt=200 p99=820. Merged rolled to 560.
zane: Aggregator small-origin heavy hitters are poisoning the merged quantile because compression removed resolution in the host-level tdigest.
priya: Immediate mitigations: 1) revert compression_level=high for telemetry rollups 2) increase centroid_budget when compression enabled 3) mark small-origin merges as low-confidence and exclude by default from SLO rollups.
luca: Revert queued and will follow up with a PR to bump centroid budget. PR: telemetry/rollups#687.
monitor-bot: job queued: revert-compression/us-east-1 id jc-687 :white_check_mark: 
zane: UI/UX: console should show a provenance/algorithm badge on percentile widgets (merge_mode=tdigest, compression=high/medium/none, centroid_budget) and surface sample_counts by origin inline.
emily: Also we should add a quantile-inversion alert rule: detect p50>p95 or p95>p99 anomalies and auto-link to origin breakdown.
priya: Long-term: separate quota telemetry (post-route compressed stream) from dashboard rollups (keep raw pre-route events for pctl SLOs). Compression can be used for billing streams but not the canonical SLO aggregates unless we raise fidelity.
luca: Action items recap: I revert compression now; then recompute rollups uncompressed for the 15m window and publish diffs. I'll open PR to increase centroid budget.
emily: Good. After revert we can compare diffs and decide whether to keep shorter window + higher-fidelity t-digest vs revert window.
monitor-bot: revert completed at 1768004458 for cluster us-east-1 (job jc-687).
emily: Thanks everyone 44 we'll watch pctl trends and follow up with a telemetry RFC on safe compression levels. :thumbsup:
